card.name: Self-directed objects after action verbs
card.fires_on: Reflexive or personal words (himself, your, you) right after a verb of acting on the body or person, and the verbs chew and spit in swallow-whole instructions. Mostly in health-advice or instruction text.

modes.label: Pronoun after verb
modes.description: A self-referring pronoun such as himself, your or you follows a verb or phrase about acting on or helping a person.
modes.example: Josephus, one of the prisoners, placed<< himself>> at the correct position in the line-up

modes.label: Chew or spit instructions
modes.description: Mouth-action verbs like chew and spit appear in directions on how to take a medicine.
modes.example: • Swallow whole. Do not<< chew>> or crush.

card.plain: It lights up on words like you, yourself, chew or spit, where text is about what a person does to or for their own body.
